expected_rollups._derivation_note: Rollups use only in-window CRs: 001, 002, 003, 005, 006. CR-004 is excluded (cr_completed_at=T-30d, before cutoff T-14d). sampleCount for each segment counts only non-null values among the in-window set. Median for even-count arrays = midpoint of two middle sorted values.

cr_cycle_submit_to_approve_days._handcomputed: In-window non-null values: 001=2.0, 002=3.0, 003=null(excluded), 005=3.0, 006=2.0. Sorted: [2.0, 2.0, 3.0, 3.0]. avg=(2+2+3+3)/4=10/4=2.5. median=(2.0+3.0)/2=2.5 (even count, midpoint of positions 2 and 3). sampleCount=4.

estimateDelta._handcomputed: In-window CRs with both deploy_window_planned AND cr_deployed_prod_at non-null: 001 delta=0.0, 002 delta=+3.0, 003 excluded(null delta — no planned/no deployed_prod), 005 delta=-3.0, 006 delta=+0.5.
